item.title: PRAXIS: A 68-Industry Benchmark for Pragmatic-Form Bias in Suggestion Mining
item.description: PRAXIS studies how suggestions are expressed through diverse pragmatic forms and introduces a benchmark spanning 68 industries to evaluate and reduce pragmatic-form bias in suggestion-mining systems.

item.title: Certified Cost-Optimal Triage for Suggestion Detection in Reviews
item.description: This work introduces a certified triage framework for routing review text efficiently, reducing LLM inference costs while maintaining high precision in actionable suggestion detection.

item.title: ReviewSense: Transforming Customer Review Dynamics into Actionable Business Insights
item.description: ReviewSense combines clustering, LLM adaptation and expert evaluation to convert unstructured customer reviews into targeted, business-facing recommendations.
